title: The placester WordPress plugin through 1.4.3 does not perform any capability, nonce or ownership check on an AJAX…
description: The placester WordPress plugin versions through 1.4.3 lack proper capability, nonce, and ownership checks on an AJAX action that updates account details. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite any user's email address, including administrators, enabling account takeover via the password-reset process.
